feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Trump and Obama hit the campaign trail. Will it make a difference for candidates?
entry.summary: With President Trump and former President Barack Obama on the campaign trail, can campaign surrogates really move the needle in high profile, high-stakes races?

entry.title: With Election Day approaching, how midterm races across the country are shaping up
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez asks veteran political strategist Doug Sosnik about the shape of the midterm race as Election Day draws closer.

entry.title: Middle East policy expert discusses Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu
entry.summary: NPR's A Martínez asks Israel and Middle East policy expert Shira Efron whether President Trump's endorsement of Benjamin Netanyahu will have an impact on Israel's election.

entry.title: Nearly 80 activists detained by Israel while helping Palestinians harvest olives
entry.summary: An unprecedented mass detention unfolds in the occupied West Bank as Israeli forces detain nearly 80 activists, including American rabbis and a congressional nominee helping Palestinians pick olives.

entry.title: Former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor on Trump's embrace of Russia
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor about President Trump's embrace of Russia as envoy Steve Witkoff visits Moscow after meeting Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

entry.title: High health costs squeeze workers, even if you have good insurance through a job
entry.summary: About 157 million Americans get their health insurance through work. A survey of employers shows a moderate price uptick this year, but workers still say health costs are a top concern.

entry.title: Can a dream help you solve a problem? Here's how to try tonight
entry.summary: What can you learn from dreams and how can you remember them and steer them to the topics you wish to dream about. Allison Aubrey and A Martinez discuss the resurgance in dream research and how dreams are a tool for self-discovery.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: President Trump and former President Obama are on the campaign trail for the midterms, U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible post-midterms attack on Iran, Musk says SpaceX and Tesla could merge.

entry.title: John Legend talks about his new album, 'Muse'
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with singer and songwriter John Legend about his new album, "Muse," which he describes as having a "Black James Bond aesthetic."

entry.title: Backlash from attack ad upends Ohio gubernatorial race
entry.summary: An ad from Republican Vivek Ramaswamy's campaign for governor shows his opponent's mother calling her a liar, amid accounts by Democrat Amy Acton of an abusive childhood.
